name: Realme Buds 2
subtitle: Wired Earphones with Mic and Bass
tagline: Bass-focused wired listening for everyday use
description: Realme Buds 2 are wired in-ear earphones with 11.2 mm drivers, a built-in microphone and 3-button remote. Magnetic earbuds and a braided cable add everyday convenience, while the 3.5 mm connector supports compatible phones, tablets, laptops and other audio devices.
story: Built for users who prefer the simplicity of wired audio, Realme Buds 2 combine practical controls with a familiar in-ear design. The in-line remote lets you adjust volume, manage playback and handle calls without reaching for your device. Magnetic earpieces can be joined together when not in use, while the 1.25 metre braided cable provides useful reach for daily listening. With a standard 3.5 mm connector, they suit compatible devices that still include a headphone jack.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
